original_title: Bombings in Greece Target Governing Party Members, Officials Say

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Bombings targeting governing party members and officials indicate a high level of threat to personnel and potentially to aviation and cargo if the attacks escalate or spread to other areas such as airports or logistics hubs.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased security measures are expected in the short term, potentially causing disruptions to transport and logistics. Further attacks or retaliations are possible.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Long-term stability in the region could be compromised if such attacks continue, potentially affecting trade, aviation, and tourism. Enhanced security protocols may become the new norm.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Transport and logistics operations may face increased scrutiny and security checks, potentially leading to delays. Aviation could be indirectly affected if security at airports is heightened, causing operational slowdowns.
ai_analysis.proximity_alert: YAKIN TEHDİT: Thessaloniki International Airport (13 km)
